verdict.rationale: Semgrep documents one first-party bulk operation: Managed Scans lets you bulk onboard and scan many repositories at once without changing your CI. Beyond that single mention, nothing shows bulk actions on findings, such as mass triage, mass ignore, or bulk ticket creation. Missing for 10: documented bulk triage or update of findings, bulk actions via the API or CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk onboarding.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: consider Semgrep Managed Scans, which enables you to bulk onboard and scan your repositories without requiring changes to your CI
